thread:
Rachael (PM): Ok team — kickoff for smart-routing fallback prioritization. Goal: define tiers, region affinity, compatible model families, and launch gates for v1. Customers: legal pilot (HIPAA) and fintech pilot. Need acceptance criteria by EOD Friday. Thoughts?

Omar (Eng-Platform): +1. Proposed approach: tier 0 (prod-critical) -> same-model-family only, region pinning; tier 1 (best-effort) -> model-family fallback allowed if latency < 200ms; tier 2 (background) -> any compatible quantized variant. I'll paste quick matrix.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Matrix:
```
Tier | Primary | Fallback policy | Region affinity
0    | redwood-v1 | none unless explicit failover to identical family | strict
1    | redwood-v1 | allow redwood-v0.9 with perf guardrails | soft
2    | community-quant | allow any compatible variant | none
```

Kevin (SRE): SLOs: tier 0 99.95% p99 < 120ms, tier 1 p99 < 250ms, tier 2 best-effort. Edge case: KV cache incompatibility across model families will cause huge latency spike. Need prefix cache partitioning or warmup.

Leah (Research): Compatibility note: some model families change tokenization. Fallback must include tokenizer compatibility check. If incompatible, do immediate circuit to alternate region, not model family fallback.

Rachael (PM): Good call. Add to acceptance criteria: fallback must preserve semantics for function-calling and tool calls; no silent tokenization mismatch.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Implementation plan: arbiter service picks candidate pool by policy, runs quick compatibility checks (tokenizer signature, kv schema), then probes tail latency with 1-3 warmup tokens. If pass -> route. Otherwise -> next candidate. I'll prototype probe flow.

sre-bot: deploy ok: arbiter/v0.4 rolled to staging

Kevin (SRE): Edge-case: partial failures — model returns truncated responses. Acceptance criteria must specify detection (missing EOS within token budget) and automatic backoff to fallback or abort with structured error to caller.

Rachael (PM): Draft acceptance checklist (high-level):
- Tier mapping documented
- Compatibility checks (tokenizer + kv) implemented
- Probe/warmup flow with thresholds
- SLO targets for each tier
- Rollout plan with canary and burn-in
- Regression tests: prompt set of 200 core workflows

Omar (Eng-Platform): Timeline: spec by Thu, prototype Fri-Mon, canary next week.

Leah (Research): Customer ask: HIPAA customer requires no cross-region fallback for tier 0. Must add policy flag per tenant.

Rachael (PM): Noted. Add enterprise flag + audit logs + KMS constraint. Any blockers?

Kevin (SRE): Blocker: we need model family metadata surfaced in registry (tokenizer hash, kv schema version, quantization attr). I'll open ticket.

Omar (Eng-Platform): I'll depend on registry ticket. Also need rollout gating: 10% traffic canary, metrics: error-rate, p95 latency, token regression.

Rachael (PM): OK. Action items:
- Omar: write spec + matrix (due Thu)
- Kevin: incident-safe rollback plan + metrics (due Thu)
- Leah: compatibility test harness (due Mon)
- Rachael: gather customer constraints + launch criteria doc (due Fri)

Rachael (PM): Quick poll — are we aligned to scope v1 with region pinning for tier 0 and model-family fallback for tier 1? React with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:

Omar (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup:

Kevin (SRE): :thumbsup:

Leah (Research): :thumbsup:

Rachael (PM): Great — closing this thread. Will follow up with PRD link shortly.
